# agentest

> Offline, deterministic test checks for tool-using LLM agents. Give agentest an agent's OpenTelemetry GenAI traces (plus, optionally, its A2A AgentCard and MCP tools list) and it returns pass, fail or n/a for each of 130 checks: the 110 test IDs of the open Agentic AI Test Checklist plus 20 repo extensions (X-001 to X-020). No account, token, network or LLM judge is needed to judge. Apache-2.0, Python 3.11+, one runtime dependency (PyYAML), agent- and framework-agnostic.

Install name on PyPI: `agentest-ai` (import and CLI name: `agentest`). Until the PyPI release is live, install from the GitHub tag: `pip install "agentest-ai @ git+https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest.git@v3.3.2"`. Author: Dr Srinivas Padmanabhuni (AiEnsured / testAIng.com). Standards output is test coverage mapping, never a compliance determination.

Typical use: `agentest std run --otlp my_traces.otlp.jsonl --card agent-card.json --tools tools.json`, and in CI `agentest std run --format junit --out agentest.xml --strict` (also json, sarif, html, md, csv).

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/README.md): what it is, install, quickstart, catalogue
- [Getting started](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md): install to first report and CI gate in six steps
- [Colab quickstart](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/examples/colab_quickstart.ipynb): free CPU notebook, no login and no model; judges the bundled good and buggy agents. Valid once this file is on the default branch.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): install, your own agent, framework adapters, n/a verdicts, known limits, support
- [User guide](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md): CLI, modes, config, outputs, CI
- [Responsible Agentic AI Testing Framework v0.1](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/FRAMEWORK.md): the 110 tests in four pillars (evals, security, privacy, responsible behaviour) with control coverage, plus the five dataset v1.4.0 responsible-AI test designs (T1-020, T1-021, T3-018, T3-019, T7-017; no rules yet)
- [Coverage map JSON](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/coverage-map.json): machine-readable pillar, test and control mapping

## Using agentest on your agent

- [Instrumenting your agent](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/developers/INSTRUMENTING.md): emit the OpenTelemetry GenAI spans the checks read

- [Reading results](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/testers/READING-RESULTS.md) and [per-test guide (all 130 IDs)](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/testers/PER-TEST-GUIDE.md)
- [False positives and heuristics](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/testers/FALSE-POSITIVES.md)
- [CI integration](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/developers/CI.md) and [troubleshooting](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/developers/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)

## Standards (coverage, not compliance)

- [Standards map](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/standards/STANDARDS-MAP.md): OWASP LLM Top 10 2025, OWASP Agentic AI threats, NIST AI RMF and AI 600-1, ISO/IEC 42001 Annex A, MITRE ATLAS; codes checked against primary sources
- [Framework mapping](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/FRAMEWORK-MAPPING.md): indicative class-level crosswalk
- [Coverage on the reference agents](https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest/blob/main/docs/COVERAGE.md): how many bundled agents each check decides on
